# Paradigm Comparison

- Configuration: L336/O96, family `emf`
- Values: mean over seeds, ± the sample standard deviation; a per-channel seed is first averaged over its channels
- Pairing: every comparison uses only the seeds both sides have (n)
- Tie: a gap no larger than the pooled seed standard deviation (floor 5e-05) is a tie, not a win
- Cluster (best k): the k with the lowest mean validation loss -- chosen without the test split
- Wilcoxon p: two-sided signed-rank test on the relative gaps across cells; numerical duplicates (ARIMA, Persistence) are left out of it
